name: Caztaca Huicintli
description: The emperor's aunt, whom Saheeli and Huatli seek out to change her brother's heart.

description_citations.text: "Saheeli Rai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Huatli conspire to depose Atlacan and enlist Caztaca to prevent another war.
timeline.quote: both she and Huatli conspired to depose Atlacan Huicintli

citation.work: Saheeli Rai
citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saheeli serves as Caztaca's scribe at a meeting with Elenda and Beckett Brass, convinces them to accept a deal and seals the treaty.
timeline.quote: In the end, Saheeli convinced the other two leaders to accept the deal.

citation.work: Saheeli Rai
citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli announces an invitation to Otepec from the emperor's sister.
timeline.quote: I've received an invitation to Otepec from the emperor's sister.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The court's factions are laid out, with Atlacan opposed by Caztaca for control of the boy-emperor.
timeline.quote: Opposing Atlacan was Caztaca Huicintli, the apex priest of the Threefold Sun and eldest daughter of the late emperor.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli reveals a planned coup to depose Atlacan and place Caztaca beside the emperor.
timeline.quote: The meeting is to plan how to depose Atlacan, defang the emperor's guard, and move Caztaca to power at the emperor's side.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca approaches Saheeli aboard the ship.
timeline.quote: Apex Priestess Caztaca Huicintli, eldest daughter of the late emperor and beloved aunt to the new emperor, waved her hand, dismissing Chitlati and the bowing sailors.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca questions Saheeli about her quetzacama and learns they obey whoever holds their command codes.
timeline.quote: They're loyal to whomever holds their command codes.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca distinguishes Alta Torrezon, the land of vampires, from the continent of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: Alta Torrezon is the land of vampires.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca asks Saheeli to take notes in her own script.
timeline.quote: Take notes in your language

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli waits on the cold Sen Gael beach for the secret meeting to begin.
timeline.quote: Saheeli stood on a dark, cold beach on the eastern coast of Sen Gael, the main island of the Sens

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli recalls how unrest and doomsday cults are splitting the Church of Dusk and Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: Doomsday fervor spread across Alta Torrezon like a plague of eager fear.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca tells Saheeli that trust will be forged by shared betrayal.
timeline.quote: will be forged tonight by shared betrayal

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A guard reports that Elenda herself is among the arriving party.
timeline.quote: Elenda is with them.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda enters, glowing with a halo, and sits with Caztaca.
timeline.quote: The Venerable swept her hood back as she entered the cabin, uncovering her face and revealing a soft, steadily glowing diadem that crowned her head.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca lays out her concern that the emperor will lead the Sun Empire into another war.
timeline.quote: Our emperor will lead us to war

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda tells of schism in the Church of Dusk and a second expedition to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Pontifex Fein struggles to hold the Church of Dusk together.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Admiral Beckett Brass bursts in with armed pirates and takes control of the meeting.
timeline.quote: You came here on my ship, to haggle over nations on my island

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass demands that her coalition be recognized as a player on equal terms.
timeline.quote: my coalition demands recognition as a player of this game on equal terms.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass threatens to kill both leaders and blockade the seas if refused.
timeline.quote: Then I'll kill the two of you here and the stink of cannon smoke will choke Torrezon and Ixalan

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli urges the leaders to accept Brass's demand.
timeline.quote: Accept her demand

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca recounts the coalition's past raids on the Sun Empire's coast.
timeline.quote: They raided our fishing fleets and pillaged our temples

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca reveals the emperor is building a fleet of ten thousand ships to invade Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: The emperor is building another fleet of ten thousand ships

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca asks the coalition to burn the second Dawn Fleet and draw the army away from the capital.
timeline.quote: Burn those ships in their docks.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca gives Brass a feather, to be returned when Caztaca rules in Pachatupa in exchange for a nation.
timeline.quote: Return this to me when I rule in Pachatupa, and I will give you your nation.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The three leaders sign the contract Saheeli transcribed.
timeline.quote: One by one the three leaders signed, sealing their contract.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca says she needs swords and the warrior-poet, not admiration.
timeline.quote: I need action. I need swords. I need the warrior-poet.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli pledges that she and Huatli will be with Caztaca.
timeline.quote: Huatli and I will be with you

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca and Saheeli shake hands and leave for the ship back to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: toward the distant ship that would bear them back to Ixalan

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass crashes a Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk meeting and forces support for a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.

timeline.summary: Caztaca plots to depose her brother Atlacan, and Beckett Brass agrees to support two factions in exchange for a Brazen Coalition state.
timeline.quote: Hoping to prevent war, the emperor's sister Caztaca Huicintli plotted to depose her bellicose brother Atlacan

citation.work: Core of Paradise
citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A year later Elenda meets Huatli, Saheeli, and Caztaca to negotiate an alliance; Beckett Brass interrupts demanding support for the Brazen Coalition.
timeline.quote: The meeting was interrupted by Admiral Beckett Brass

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire builds a second Dawn Fleet and Admiral Beckett Brass crashes a meeting, agreeing to support both factions for a Coalition state.
timeline.quote: Admiral Beckett Brass crashed a meeting of the two factions
